name: Apples

description: Sweetest in early summer. Eat within a day or two.

description: Hard-skinned squash for roasting, soup and carving.

name: Kale
description: Gets sweeter after the first cold nights.

name: Sweet potatoes
description: Cured after harvest for a sweeter bite.

name: Sourdough bread
description: Long-fermented loaves baked the night before.
